questions.question: What happens to Gog's forces in Ezekiel 39?
options: They fall on the mountains of Israel and are utterly defeated
They make a binding treaty and then withdraw away in full peace
They lay siege to the great city for very many long years
They conquer the whole land and scatter all of the people
questions.answer: They fall on the mountains of Israel and are utterly defeated
